confidenceLegend.verified_sample: Price/item directly observed on that outlet's live online menu.
confidenceLegend.network_baseline: Price taken from the most complete sampled outlet (Master Canteen/Ashok Nagar) and used as the chain-wide reference.
confidenceLegend.extrapolated: Network-baseline price applied to a store with no independent source; not independently confirmed.
confidenceLegend.estimated: No online price found anywhere; value inferred from category/positioning (currently only Mutton Biryani).
